symptom: ako/mxcli#2057 (mendixlabs/mxcli#1785, mxcli 0.26.0): `CALL JAVASCRIPT ACTION "NanoflowCommons"."RefreshEntity" (EntityToRefresh = "CustomModule"."NPActivity")` reported stored with its MDL quotes, CE1613 at mxbuild.
cause: Not reproduced on main: the stored EntityTypeCodeActionParameterValue.Entity is the bare qualified name for quoted and unquoted spellings alike, and mx check (11.14, TestApp with NanoflowCommons) reports 0 errors. The entity-type branch (#1137) and its whitespace normalisation (#1171) are the fixes in that path; history here is squashed at v0.26.0, so the exact release cannot be pinned.
insight: For this class, verify with the BSON value (`mxcli bson dump --type nanoflow --object X | grep -A1 Entity`) and mx check, never describe — describe prints quoted and broken values identically. A report against an old version that main does not reproduce still earns a verbatim regression test, so a regression is caught by name.
